fit_metadata.interpretation: Exact empirical hourly marginals in law, with finite-draw sampling noise. Empirical support truncates unseen tails and does not establish joint-profile support, novelty or privacy. Beta smoothing can stay close to resampled TRAIN rows.
fit_metadata.sampling: normal @ Cholesky(R).T; shared chi-square(df)/df per day; coordinatewise t CDF
fit_metadata.source_array_encoding: C order; profiles little-endian float64; labels little-endian int64
